class TestProprietaryDatabase(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test proprietary software database."""
    
    def test_default_database(self):
        """Test default proprietary database."""
        db = ProprietaryDatabase()
        self.assertIsInstance(db.proprietary_packages, set)
        self.assertGreater(len(db.proprietary_packages), 0)
    
    def test_is_proprietary_exact_match(self):
        """Test exact match for proprietary software."""
        db = ProprietaryDatabase()
        self.assertTrue(db.is_proprietary("google-chrome"))
        self.assertTrue(db.is_proprietary("discord"))
        self.assertFalse(db.is_proprietary("firefox"))
    
    def test_is_proprietary_partial_match(self):
        """Test partial match for proprietary software."""
        db = ProprietaryDatabase()
        self.assertTrue(db.is_proprietary("google-chrome-stable"))
        self.assertTrue(db.is_proprietary("com.spotify.Client"))
    
    def test_foss_apps_not_flagged(self):
        """Test that FOSS applications are not flagged as proprietary."""
        db = ProprietaryDatabase()
        # Test common FOSS applications
        foss_apps = [
            "obs-studio", "com.obsproject.Studio",
            "gimp", "org.gimp.GIMP", 
            "blender", "org.blender.Blender",
            "telegram", "org.telegram.desktop",
            "vlc-media-player", "org.videolan.VLC",
            "mumble", "info.mumble.Mumble",
            "firefox", "org.mozilla.firefox",
            "libreoffice", "org.libreoffice.LibreOffice",
            "thunderbird", "org.mozilla.Thunderbird",
            "audacity", "org.audacityteam.Audacity",
            "krita", "org.kde.krita"
        ]
        
        for app in foss_apps:
            with self.subTest(app=app):
                self.assertFalse(db.is_proprietary(app), 
                               f"FOSS app '{app}' incorrectly flagged as proprietary")
